description: Measure Splash 1.4.0 with Qwen3.8-27B MLX affine 8-bit weights and DFlash2 speculative decoding on Apple M5 Pro. Run the full endpoint-bench profile with all eight tests, model-default reasoning, INT8 KV, FP32 recurrent states, automatic memory/context planning, and default Neural Engine prefill policy. Characterize conformance, speed, thinking, decode, prefill, needle retrieval, caching, and the pelican drawing without a preset performance threshold.
target_weights: MLX affine 8-bit quantization, group size 64; non-quantized checkpoint tensors preserved
